name: lacasadelshampoo
description: POS de escritorio Windows — La Casa del Shampoo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lcds/shared && npm run build -w @lcds/db && npm run build -w @lcds/server && npm run build -w @lcds/desktop
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @lcds/shared && npm run build -w @lcds/db && npm run build -w @lcds/server
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build:server && npm run tauri -w @lcds/desktop -- build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lcds/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lcds/db && npm run typecheck -w @lcds/server && npm run typecheck -w @lcds/desktop
